titleEn: Create a campaign draft with cost estimate

en: How do I send an offer to my customers?
How much will a campaign cost?

steps: Name (private), audience: saved segment / tag / everyone who agreed
Pick an approved MARKETING template and fill variables (fixed text, customer name with fallback, tracked link)
Review cost then Send now or Schedule
edgeCases: Number quality drops to YELLOW/RED or WhatsApp restricts the account: campaigns auto-pause, no new templates until recovered; campaigns never restart by themselves
On the shared platform number: marketing templates are refused, templates come from the platform catalogue, wallet pays Meta
gaps: Approved marketing template list is empty for own-number merchants until a Templates screen exists
assistantNote: a draft sends nothing; deleting it is free
